observations.source_title: U.S. State Life Expectancy by Sex, 2021
observations.source_notes: Life expectancy at birth from NCHS annual complete period life tables. The source publishes a standard error; the margin of error stored with each observation is 1.645 x that standard error (90% confidence).

observations.definition: Age-adjusted deaths by suicide per 100,000 residents of the same sex.
observations.source_title: Underlying Cause of Death, 2018-2024, Single Race
observations.source_notes: Note: the source link opens CDC WONDER's query page, not a finished table. CDC does not offer a direct link to these figures. To reproduce this number there: accept the data use terms, group results by Sex, then State, tick "Age Adjusted Rate", choose year 2024, and under cause of death choose Injury Intent: Suicide. Rates are age-adjusted to the 2000 U.S. standard population. CDC withholds any figure based on fewer than ten deaths.

observations.definition: Share of seats in the state legislature (both chambers combined).
observations.source_notes: Figures for 2026, from the State Legislature table on CAWP's Alaska page. CAWP counts women legislators only. The share shown for men is every seat not held by a woman, so it also includes any seats that were vacant at the time.

observations.definition: Sentenced prisoners under state or federal jurisdiction per 100,000 residents of the same sex.
observations.source_notes: From Table 7 of BJS's "Prisoners in 2023 - Statistical Tables" (the source link opens the publication page; the table is in the PDF there). Sentenced prisoners per 100,000 residents of the same sex, December 31, 2023. This state runs prisons and jails as one system, so its figures include jail populations as well as prisoners. That makes it not strictly comparable with most other states.
